'''Acceleration webbing''' was found wrapped around neatly stacked piles of metal [[ingot]]s in the treasure room of the [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] [[Vagaari plunder ship|plunder ship]] after it was captured by [[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] in the [[Skirmish in the Crustai system|skirmish between the Chiss and Vagaari]] in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].<ref name="OBF" />
